summary: Hansjakob Seiler (1920–2018) was a linguist who studied under Manu Leumann around 1940 to 1947. He held a post at the University of Cologne from approximately 1959 to 1986.

Hanung Kim specializes in Tibetology and history/archaeology. Kim earned a master's degree from Columbia University and completed a PhD at Harvard University under doctoral supervisor Leonard van der Kuijp.

Har Bilas Sarda (1867–1955) was an Indology and history/archaeology scholar. He studied at the University of Calcutta from around 1886 to 1888 and served as a judge at the Court of Small Causes, Ajmer, around 1923 to 1924.
Har Dayal (1884–1939) worked in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Delhi from around 1901 to 1903 and at SOAS University of London between roughly 1927 and 1932.
Indologist Har Dutt Sharma (d. 1942) earned his doctorate under Moriz Winternitz. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of Delhi and is attested at Hindu College, Delhi, in 1957.

Hara Prasad Sastri (1853–1931) worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and history/archaeology. He served as Principal at Sanskrit College and University (attested 1905) and as Joint Philological Secretary at The Asiatic Society (attested 1905–1911).
Harabhatta Sastri was an Indologist. He held posts at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, where he was attested as a Pandit in 1918 and further attested in 1922 and 1945.
Harabhatha Shastri was an Indologist who held a post at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, attested in 1911 and attested as a Pandit in 1916.

Indologist Harald Christian Rasmussen (1853–1904) studied under Michael Viggo Fausbøll at the University of Copenhagen (kand.theol. ~1871–1877; Ph.D. 1892). He served at De forenede Kirkeskoler as schoolteacher (1875), Senior Teacher (1882), and Skoleinspektør (1889).

Archaeologist Harald Hauptmann (1936–2018) earned his doctorate at Heidelberg (1964) and habilitated at FU Berlin (1978). He worked at Heidelberg University (1980–1994), Heidelberg Academy of Sciences (1989), and as First Director at DAI Istanbul (1994–2001).

Harald Hundius (1939–2019) worked in Buddhist studies and linguistics, studying under Singkha Wannasai. He was a lecturer at Chiang Mai University in 1983 and a professor at the University of Passau from around 1993 to 2004.
Harald Wiese earned his Dr. habil. at the University of Leipzig and was appointed professor there in 1994. His fields include Indology.

Haraprasad Shastri (1853–1931) studied at Presidency University, Sanskrit College, and Sampurnanand Sanskrit University. His posts included Principal at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (1900–1908) and Bengali/Sanskrit department head at the University of Dhaka (1921–1924).

Hari Damodar Velankar (1898–1967) was an Indologist who studied under Hari Mahadev Bhadkamkar. He served as Professor of Sanskrit at Wilson College, Mumbai (attested 1944–1948) and Joint Director at Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (attested 1959–1960).
Hari Pratap Kailash works in philosophy and Indology. He completed an MBBS at AIIMS (2000–2005), an MA at Jawaharlal Nehru University (2008–2010), and a PhD at the University of Delhi (2010–2015).
Hari Shankar Prasad works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Banaras Hindu University and under Ramakant Tripathi and Jan Willem de Jong.

Haridas Bhattacharyya (1891–1956) worked in philosophy and religious studies. Educated at Scottish Church College and the University of Calcutta, he taught at Scottish Church College (1915), the University of Calcutta (1917), and the University of Dhaka (1921).
Harikrishna Sharma K. N. works in Indology and philosophy. He was an assistant professor at V.T.B. College from 2011 to 2012 and at Sree Sankara College in 2012.

Harish Chandra Gupta, who studied at Government College Sanjauli (1991–1994), worked at the National Library of India (attested 1970). He later held posts at Oriental College of Technology (2010–2017) and L. N. M. Infra Projects (2017–2024).
Harish Chandra Mani Tripathi is an Indologist who studied under Karunapati Tripathi. He served as Publication Officer at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (attested 1996).
